notes: CONFLICT: GSM5695811 title says pnp (E_coli_pnp_3end_seq_MOPS_comp) but ch:genotype says wildtype and ch:strain K-12 MG1655; genotype labels and is_control left out for it. Most libraries are 3' end sequencing or Rend-seq (end_mapping); 3end_seq of sucrose gradient fractions also set end_mapping (both gradient fraction and end library). Only *_RNA_seq_* titles are total_rnaseq. Samples without exp/stat in the title get mid_exponential as study default (protocol: exponential harvest at OD600 <= 0.3; summary: steady-state growth); 'stat' samples = early stationary (shortly after plateau) -> transition. LB carbon source not given. No shaking/aeration described, so oxygen and culture_mode left out. rRNA removal not stated.

assay_class.q: For 3’ end sequencing the Rend-seq protocol was modified in a way that 3’ end ligation (5'_App/CTGTAGGCACCATCAAT/3ddC_3') was done preceding fragmentation for 2min.
RNA-seq for E. coli Δpnp, Δrnb, ΔpcnB and MG1655 wildtype was executed as described in (Parker et al., Cell Systems 2020).
Rend-seq libraries were prepared as described in (Lalanne et al., Cell 2018) with 25s RNA fragmentation.
